Theatre show
A whole show of a small theatre: fourteen lights with a drawn stage under them, twenty-one memories with looks and sequences, and a stack of fourteen cues from the house lights to the bows.
What is in it
  • Channels 1 to 17: fire pots, front, back blue, a spot, an LED bar (red, green, blue, white), a hazer, a mirror ball and the house light. The notes under the faders name them.
  • Memories 1 to 10: looks, like warm wash, blue night, sunset and full stage.
  • Memories 11 to 21: sequences: fire flicker, a chase of the back, a breathing blue, a strobe, a storm, colors, an intro and a finale that run once.
  • The stack: cue 1 is the house light; 3.5 and 4.1 were put in between later; 4.1 and 6.0 go on by themselves after their wait.
  • The keys of the independents: the house light, haze, the mirror ball and some memories at hand.
Try it
  1. Press Stack, then Play for each cue. Watch Stage: the lights shine in their colors over the drawing of the stage.
  2. Solo up and a key under a fader: only that light, at full, while the key is held.
  3. The memory keys of the independents switch the fire, the chase or the haze on top of any cue.
  4. Stop the show with Stack, change a cue on the Stack view, and play it again.
